title: Cash movements
html:
5.3.1Settlement, invoice-level settlement

When recording financial transactions it may happen that the item cannot be linked to an invoice. In that case the transaction is posted to the current account of the given partner. These unmatched items can be reviewed in the Invoice-level settlement menu.

By searching for the partner's name you can list every unmatched item and link them using the check boxes at the beginning of the rows.

5.3.2Compensation notices

Receivables from and liabilities to the same partner can also be settled by compensation. Open the New compensation menu and find the partner you need.

Note

If the partner does not have both kinds of open items, the compensation cannot be carried out — the program displays a warning message.

If the partner has both supplier and customer invoices, the program lists the invoices that can be involved. The invoices are selected manually. The Calculate button computes the amount to be compensated and the remaining balance.

You can include or remove invoices by ticking and unticking the check boxes. Once the invoices are selected, decide what happens to the invoices left with a balance: include them in a new compensation, or settle them by transfer.

Finalisation has two levels: the Finalise button saves the compensation, and the Approve button closes it. A notice can be printed for a closed compensation, or it can be reversed. The Execute compensation button performs the actual compensation.
